tuan: ran the long-context synthetic KV bench (seq len ~32k, mixed reads/writes) on staging. after ~4h we see steady RSS growth (~1.8GB -> 3.6GB) and a sharp fragmentation spike. not sure if this is compaction regression or kernel selector change. attaching flamegraphs and heap hist, trying to triage.

perf-bot: CI: started perf-suite long-context-kv (run id 2129998890) :gear:

maria: which commit/branch? any recent KV changes or kernel-selection tweaks?

tuan: main@c3f2b9a — we merged the kernel-selector heuristic and a batching tweak yesterday (batcher: prefer short-packed batches under high concurrency). no other KV changes AFAIK. gist: https://gist.github.com/rw/tiny/kvbench-meta

alex: can you paste the top allocation site? also try KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 and run with --kv-compact-threshold=0.6 to force compaction early. quick repro command: 

```bash
KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 ./bench_kv --long-context --seq-len 32000 --workers 8 --duration 6h 
```

(tip: add --kv-compact-sleep=10s to accelerate compaction cycles)

`tuan`: top allocation snippet (heap hist):
```
- 38% - kv_slot_fragment (obj)
- 21% - kv_extent_unfrozen
- 12% - batch_io_buf
- 9%  - kv_slot_meta
- rest ~20% small allocs
```

we also see repeated small extents that never get coalesced; RSS climbs while free lists remain non-empty.

jordana: sounds like compaction thresholds not triggering under the new kernel/batching mix. we hit something similar in feb — slab rotation + delayed compaction caused tiny retained extents. try forcing aggressive reuse and enable the compact-on-evict flag. also check the kv-slot-rotation counters (metrics) for stuck slots.

tuan: running an aggressive run now with commands below, will paste results in ~30m:

```bash
KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 KV_COMPACT_MODE=aggressive ./bench_kv --long-context --seq-len 32000 --workers 8 --duration 2h --kv-compact-threshold=0.45 --kv-compact-on-evict=1
```

perf-bot: CI: perf-suite long-context-kv finished (run id 2129998890). summary: baseline mem 1.9GB -> current 3.5GB (+84%), fragmentation index +2.1. artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/2129998890

maria: can you upload the flamegraph and heap hist to the ticket? I can run a short sampling profiler against the same commit to see hot allocation paths. also, did the kernel selector change the kernel chosen for long context runs? (maybe switching to a kernel that favors latency but creates more small allocations)

tuan: uploaded flamegraph + heap hist to the gist above. flamegraph shows heavy time in kv_slot_alloc and kv_extent_split. running a profiler now and will post when done. thanks for the tips — will also try reverting the kernel selector patch in a local branch to see impact. :thumbsup:

alex: if you have the CI artifacts, try running the bench under the memory sanitizer build (only for short runs) or with jemalloc stats to inspect extent fragmentation. last time jemalloc showed a bunch of dirty pages that never got reused.

tuan: noted — will run jemalloc stats next. I'll update this thread with the repro command and minimal patch once I have a narrow test case. thanks everyone.
